name: incident-summary
description: Summarises an incident channel into a post-mortem draft. Use when an incident is closed and the user asks for the write-up.
---

# Incident summary

1. Read the incident channel from the first alert to the all-clear.
2. Draft the summary in the format below, then compare every time in it with the
   channel's timestamps, for example the first alert and the all-clear.
3. Hand the draft to the incident owner; the timeline it needs is in
   [timeline.md](references/timeline.md).

## Output format

A title naming the service and the date, then what users saw, then the cause, then
what was changed so it does not happen again. Each part is a short paragraph.
